data.situation:
On Monday, 20 September, Lin and Maya returned to the studio with their paper collar. The teacher led them past the material drawer to the display table. A curved wooden sculpture stood beside a small statue of a woman holding a lantern. The museum had lent the statue for a week of studio study. The teacher had asked to keep it through the performance on 27 September, but that extension and public display still needed approval. The statue's raised hand gave it a distinctive outline. Lin tried the gesture on the girl's puppet to see how she might hold the station lamp. Beside the work lay a card from the sculptor, describing how she had shaped the fingers. Maya preferred the lantern lower, where its light would fall across the empty chair. It was an aesthetic choice: one position made the figure look dramatic, while the other made it look welcoming. They photographed both arrangements before deciding. The teacher asked them to keep the card with the borrowed work. WORK ON LOAN — STUDIO STUDY ONLY UNTIL DISPLAY IS APPROVED
The wooden sculpture and the lantern statue are separate pieces. The sculptor asks us to keep the statue's raised hand clear of the label. For the puppet design, choose the outline you prefer, then write one sentence explaining your aesthetic choice. Both sketches can stay beside the work. Keep the artist's card with the statue; the teacher will confirm its return date with the museum.

readingBlocks.zh: 9月20日星期一，林和玛雅带着纸衣领回到工作室。老师领她们经过材料抽屉，来到作品台。一件弯曲的木雕旁立着一尊小雕像，是个提灯的女人。博物馆把雕像借给工作室，用于为期一周的学习。老师已申请延长借期，留到9月27日演出结束，但延期和公开展示仍需批准。她抬起的手使轮廓格外容易辨认。林在女孩木偶上试了试这个动作，看看她可以怎样举着车站的灯。作品旁放着雕塑家的说明卡，介绍她怎样塑出手指。玛雅更喜欢把灯放低，让光落在空椅子上。这是审美上的选择：一种姿势显得富有戏剧性，另一种显得亲切。她们拍下了两种摆法才做决定。老师请她们把说明卡和借来的作品放在一起。

readingBlocks.en:
WORK ON LOAN — STUDIO STUDY ONLY UNTIL DISPLAY IS APPROVED
The wooden sculpture and the lantern statue are separate pieces. The sculptor asks us to keep the statue's raised hand clear of the label. For the puppet design, choose the outline you prefer, then write one sentence explaining your aesthetic choice. Both sketches can stay beside the work. Keep the artist's card with the statue; the teacher will confirm its return date with the museum.
readingBlocks.zh:
借用作品——展示获批前仅供工作室学习
木雕和提灯雕像是两件独立作品。雕塑家请我们不要让展签挡住雕像抬起的手。设计木偶时，选好你更喜欢的轮廓，再用一句话说明审美上的选择。两张草图都可以放在作品旁。艺术家说明卡要和雕像放在一起，老师会向博物馆确认归还日期。

glossary.note: 可数名词sculpture，本句弯曲木质立体艺术作品，不指雕塑创作活动。
glossary.example: A curved wooden sculpture stood beside a small statue of a woman holding a lantern.
glossary.exampleZh: 一件弯曲的木雕旁立着一尊小雕像，是个提灯的女人。

externalEvidence.definition: a three-dimensional work of plastic art

glossary.note: 人物名词sculptor，本句说明卡的写作者创作雕塑。
glossary.example: Beside the work lay a card from the sculptor, describing how she had shaped the fingers.
glossary.exampleZh: 作品旁放着雕塑家的说明卡，介绍她怎样塑出手指。

glossary.note: 可数名词statue，本句为提灯女人的人像；与抽象木雕区分。
glossary.example: The wooden sculpture and the lantern statue are separate pieces.
glossary.exampleZh: 木雕和提灯雕像是两件独立作品。

externalEvidence.definition: a sculpture representing a human or animal

glossary.note: 形容词aesthetic修饰choice，与造型美感有关，不断言一定美观。
glossary.example: It was an aesthetic choice: one position made the figure look dramatic, while the other made it look welcoming.
glossary.exampleZh: 这是审美上的选择：一种姿势显得富有戏剧性，另一种显得亲切。

externalEvidence.definition: relating to or dealing with the subject of aesthetics

glossary.zh: 有显著特点、容易辨认的
glossary.note: 形容词distinctive修饰outline，表示有容易辨认的特点。
glossary.example: The statue's raised hand gave it a distinctive outline.
glossary.exampleZh: 她抬起的手使轮廓格外容易辨认。

externalEvidence.definition: of a feature that helps to distinguish a person or thing- Curtis Wilkie

retrievalPrompts.function: The figure with one raised hand
retrievalPrompts.cue: Caption the table photograph so an absent partner can distinguish the sculpture from the statue.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 给作品台照片写一句图注，让没来的搭档能分清木雕和人物雕像。
acceptableAnswers: There is a curved wooden sculpture beside a statue of a woman holding a lantern.

retrievalPrompts.function: The figure with one raised hand
retrievalPrompts.cue: A visitor recognises the figure at once. Point out the feature that makes its outline distinctive.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 访客一眼认出了这尊人物雕像。指出哪个动作让它的轮廓容易辨认。
acceptableAnswers: The statue has a distinctive outline because one hand is raised.

retrievalPrompts.function: The figure with one raised hand
retrievalPrompts.cue: Choose the higher or lower lantern position and justify the aesthetic effect. Credit the sculptor's card.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 在高举灯和低举灯之间作选择，说明审美效果，并交代说明卡来自雕塑家。
acceptableAnswers: I would choose the lower lantern because it makes the figure look welcoming. That is an aesthetic choice; the card is from the sculptor.
